results.title: Performance Engineering Efficient AI
results.content: Machine learning system efficiency requires balancing trade-offs across algorithmic complexity, computational resources, and data utilization. ***Machine Learning System Efficiency*** is the optimization of ML systems to minimize *computational*, *memory*, and *energy* demands while maintaining performance, achieved through improvements in *algorithms*, *hardware utilization*, and *data usage*.
